title: The footer comment stays where it was when the last item of a nested sequence is removed
notes: The comment is indented as the removed item, not more, so it is a footer of the collection and stays (`edit/remove-last-key-keeps-footer-comment`). The emptied sequence is written `[]` on the line of its parent, never an empty value (docs/edit-semantics.md). The comment keeps its text and its line. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the engine refused this removal at an earlier revision; the native backend now moves the comment inside the brackets and the pure backend leaves it.
